title: ADAM12 promotes temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma by activating the TNF-alpha - NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Cheng, Chunchao; Cui, Longtao; Cui, Xiaoteng; Zhan, Qi; Ju, Jiasheng; Hong, Biao; Huang, Yanping; Ding, Yaqing; Xu, Hanyi; Qiu, Tian; Kang, Chunsheng; Liu, Xiaomin; Wang, Qixue; Zeng, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ADAM12通过TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路促进胶质母细胞瘤TMZ耐药，仅用对接预测蛋白互作，核心是肿瘤耐药机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Development of temozolomide (TMZ) resistance is a critical factor contributing to a poor prognosis in glioma patients. TMZ resistance is also closely associated with the phosphorylation level of NF-kappaB, yet targeted inhibition of NF-kappaB activity in glioma can be leveraged to overcome TMZ resistance. ADAM12, a protein significantly overexpressed in glioma cells, is implicated in the pathogenesis and progression of glioma, yet its role in the development of TMZ resistance is completely understood. We found that knockdown of ADAM12 was shown to arrest the glioma cell cycle, enhance apoptosis, inhibit DNA damage repair mechanisms, and sensitize glioma cells to TMZ. Targeting ADAM12 in vivo was found to increase the sensitivity of glioma cells to TMZ. Survival analysis indicated that ADAM12 serves as a prognostic marker for TMZ treatment. Using ELISA and protein interaction predictions via docking simulation, we identified the TNF-alpha shedding function of ADAM12 as a critical regulator of glioma progression. Furthermore, in glioma cell lines with unmethylated MGMT, the knockdown of ADAM12 enhanced sensitivity to TMZ by inhibiting the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway and reducing MGMT expression. In all, these results demonstrated that ADAM12 aids in shedding of membrane-bound TNF-a to drive TMZ resistance in glioma.
abstract_zh: 替莫唑胺（TMZ）耐药性的产生是导致胶质瘤患者预后不良的关键因素。TMZ耐药性与NF-kappaB的磷酸化水平密切相关，然而在胶质瘤中靶向抑制NF-kappaB活性可用于克服TMZ耐药性。ADAM12是一种在胶质瘤细胞中显著过表达的蛋白质，参与胶质瘤的发病机制和进展，但其在TMZ耐药性发展中的作用尚未完全阐明。我们发现，敲低ADAM12可阻滞胶质瘤细胞周期、增强凋亡、抑制DNA损伤修复机制，并使胶质瘤细胞对TMZ敏感化。体内靶向ADAM12被发现能增加胶质瘤细胞对TMZ的敏感性。生存分析表明，ADAM12可作为TMZ治疗的预后标志物。通过ELISA和对接模拟的蛋白质相互作用预测，我们确定了ADAM12的TNF-alpha脱落功能是胶质瘤进展的关键调控因子。此外，在MGMT未甲基化的胶质瘤细胞系中，敲低ADAM12通过抑制TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路并降低MGMT表达，增强了对TMZ的敏感性。总之，这些结果表明ADAM12通过促进膜结合TNF-a的脱落来驱动胶质瘤中的TMZ耐药性。
